summary: Policy for scripts/check-product-identity.py: SlopTank is a fork of Jellyfin and must not present Jellyfin's product identity (name, logo, tagline, donation and support channels) as its own, per the upstream trademark policy at https://jellyfin.org/docs/project/branding/. Compatibility identifiers (wire protocol, plugin ABI, package names, persisted data identity) and GPL attribution are explicitly permitted and must never be flagged: removing those breaks running software or violates the licence, which is worse than the problem this guard solves.

compatibility.matching: identity_rules patterns are Python regexes applied case-insensitively to each line of every git-tracked text file; a rule with a paths regex only scans matching POSIX repo-relative paths. allowlist entries are tested first and win. forbidden_paths match paths, forbidden_blobs match the SHA-256 of file bytes.
compatibility.forward_compat: Additive only. New optional fields may be added at any time; readers ignore unknown fields. Removing or redefining a field requires a schema_version bump.
compatibility.shipping: This file and the checker ship byte-identically in both public product repositories (SlopTank and SlopTank-server). Rules scoped to paths that exist in only one repo are harmless in the other, so one shared policy covers both.

identity_rules.title: Root README titled as Jellyfin
identity_rules.reason: The repository front page presenting itself as Jellyfin is the clearest violation of the fork rule ('any fork ... must use a different name and logo'). A provenance line such as 'based on Jellyfin' remains welcome and unflagged.

must_pass.line: A customized media server based on Jellyfin
A customized web client based on Jellyfin Web

identity_rules.title: Jellyfin brand-asset repository referenced
identity_rules.reason: jellyfin-ux (and its @jellyfin/ux-web npm form) is upstream's branding asset repository; referencing it embeds the trademarked logo as this product's own. Functional packages such as @jellyfin/sdk are compatibility identifiers and stay.

identity_rules.title: Donations directed to Jellyfin
identity_rules.reason: Soliciting donations to Jellyfin, Inc. from this product's pages misdirects supporters and implies official status.

identity_rules.title: Jellyfin project tagline used as ours
identity_rules.reason: 'The Free Software Media System' is Jellyfin's project tagline; shipping it as this product's description claims Jellyfin's identity.

must_pass.line: as published by the Free Software Foundation; either version 2

identity_rules.title: Assembly identity claims Jellyfin
identity_rules.reason: AssemblyProduct flows to /System/Info ProductName (the name every client displays) and AssemblyCompany claims the build's producer. AssemblyCopyright is mandatory GPL attribution and must stay verbatim; it is allowlisted, never flagged.

must_pass.line: [assembly: AssemblyCopyright("Copyright (c) 2019 Jellyfin Contributors. Code released under the GNU General Public License")]

identity_rules.title: API presented as the Jellyfin API
identity_rules.reason: The Swagger document title and OpenAPI info title are user-visible product naming on /api-docs. Nominative references to the Jellyfin.Api namespace or prose about the API are unaffected: only the quoted display string is identity.

must_pass.line: /// Extension method for adding the Jellyfin API to the service collection.

identity_rules.title: Server localized UI copy names Jellyfin
identity_rules.reason: Emby.Server.Implementations/Localization/Core strings are user-visible product copy (update notices, the startup splash). Upstream merges reintroduce 'Jellyfin Server' in dozens of locales at once. Scoped to the locale JSON files: the Localization C# code legitimately uses Jellyfin in internal identifiers and comments (class B, not user-visible identity).

must_flag.line: "NewVersionIsAvailable": "A new version of Jellyfin Server is available for download.",
"StartupEmbyServerIsLoading": "Jellyfin Server is loading. Please try again shortly.",

identity_rules.title: Web app identity names Jellyfin
identity_rules.reason: src/index.html (page title, application-name) and src/manifest.json (PWA name, short_name, description) are the web client's own identity surfaces.

must_pass.line: "description": "Your media library, streamed to any screen",

identity_rules.title: Web localized UI strings name Jellyfin
identity_rules.reason: src/strings is the web client's user-visible copy in every locale; upstream merges reintroduce Jellyfin-branded strings there.

must_flag.line: "StartupMessage": "Jellyfin Server is loading. Please try again shortly.",

forbidden_paths.title: Jellyfin-named logo asset
forbidden_paths.reason: A tracked file whose basename is jellyfin.svg/ico/png is upstream's fin logo shipping under its own name (e.g. the Swagger header logo at Jellyfin.Server/wwwroot/api-docs/jellyfin.svg). Nominative asset names for upstream's own plugins (jellyfin-plugin-*.svg) do not match.

forbidden_blobs.title: Upstream Jellyfin.Server.ico (trademarked fin application icon)
forbidden_blobs.reason: The upstream application icon is the trademarked fin mark itself. The filename Jellyfin.Server.ico stays (it tracks the class C project name); the bytes must stay replaced. Matched by hash so an upstream merge cannot smuggle it back under any path.

forbidden_blobs.title: Upstream api-docs jellyfin.svg (trademarked fin Swagger logo)
forbidden_blobs.reason: The fin logo formerly served to browsers as the Swagger UI header. Matched by hash so it cannot return under a renamed path.

allowlist.reason: GPL-2.0 licence text is mandatory attribution and must stay verbatim (class D).
CONTRIBUTORS.md is GPL attribution of upstream authorship and must stay (class D).
AssemblyCopyright carries the mandatory upstream GPL copyright notice; stripping it is a licence violation (class D).
Provenance statements ('based on Jellyfin', 'forked from Jellyfin') are accurate descriptive use the trademark policy explicitly permits, and honesty about the fork is wanted (class D).
This policy file necessarily contains the forbidden strings as its own patterns and samples.

clean_samples.why: MediaBrowser auth scheme token: the server requires this literal; renaming it breaks every request (class C).
Legacy client auth headers are wire protocol (class C).
Third-party npm package specifier; not our branding (class C).
Third-party npm package specifier; not our branding (class C).
Installed server plugins call this global at runtime (class C).
UDP discovery handshake literal every third-party client sends (class C).
JELLYFIN_* environment variables are deployed configuration surface (class C).
Persisted data identity; renaming requires a live-data migration (class C).
emby-* CSS classes are a styling contract with user Custom CSS (class C).
Must match the server's default plugin repository (class C).
Names Jellyfin's real plugin repository, which genuinely is Jellyfin's (class C/D).
Documents the behaviour of the upstream server software; descriptive use (class D).
CI provisions the real server fork whose project paths are class C names.
